newsitem.title: EGYPT: Palestinians ask Arabs to isolate Israel.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians ask Arabs to isolate Israel.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority asked Arab governments on Thursday to isolate and punish Israel for its actions in the West Bank and Gaza.

"We implore you to provide help and work by every means to isolate Israel, punish it and show up its aggression until it refrains from this perverse aggressive behaviour," Palestinian delegate Mohamed Sobeih told an Arab League meeting in Cairo.
"Until it refrains from trampling underfoot all U.N. resolutions...so that no more blood is shed," he added.

Sobeih was addressing an emergency meeting of permanent delegates to the Arab League, called by the Palestinians in response to Israel's decision to reopen a tunnel under the Wailing Wall in Jerusalem. Fifteen Palestinians have been shot dead in the Palestinian territories in the subsequent protests.
"Palestinian land has been turned into fields of war, on which many martyrs have fallen," Sobeih added.
Arab League Secretary-General Esmat Abdel-Meguid opened the meeting with a call for a moment's silence for the dead.
Abdel-Meguid called the Israeli response to Palestinian protests "a savage barbaric attack".

The one-day meeting is expected to condemn Israel's conduct over the past two days and demand that the new Israeli government accept the same terms for peace talks agreed with the previous government.
Protests continued on Thursday against the tunnel and at the Israeli government's policies towards Palestinians.
Palestinian health officials said 15 Palestinians have been shot dead in clashes with Israeli soldiers over two days.

Sources at Rafah clinic in the Gaza Strip said Mohammed Bayoumi, 14, was shot dead at Rafah, raising to seven the number of Palestinians killed in the Strip. Health officials in the West Bank said three were killed in clashes there. Five were killed on Wednesday.
